test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 67 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 66 km/hr, and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 17 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire journey is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
When equal distances are covered at speeds **s₁**, **s₂**, and **s₃**, the **Average Speed** = 3 × s₁ × s₂ × s₃ ÷ (s₁s₂ + s₂s₃ + s₃s₁).

Average Speed = (3 × 67 × 66 × 17) ÷ (67 × 66 + 66 × 17 + 17 × 67)

Average Speed = 225522 ÷ (4422 + 1122 + 1139) = 225522 ÷ 6683 ≈ 33.745 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 33.7 kmph.**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb7337969f55ad6080f0321dbc5fa5b126bda1ee339b0180ee395099a2192a1b.png] 
**Given:** Speeds s₁ = 67 km/hr, s₂ = 66 km/hr, s₃ = 17 km/hr. Each covers 1/3rd distance.

**Formula Used:** Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Let total distance be 3 units. Then each part is 1 unit.

⇒ Total Time = (1 ÷ 67) + (1 ÷ 66) + (1 ÷ 17)

⇒ Total Time = (66 × 17 + 67 × 17 + 67 × 66) ÷ (67 × 66 × 17)

⇒ Total Time = (1122 + 1139 + 4422) ÷ 75174 = 6683 ÷ 75174

⇒ Average Speed = 3 ÷ (6683 ÷ 75174)

⇒ Average Speed = (3 × 75174) ÷ 6683 = 225522 ÷ 6683

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 33.745 km/hr ≈ 33.7 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 33.7 kmph.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

For two equal distances covered at speeds a and b, Average Speed = 2ab ÷ (a + b).

Relative Speed

Objects moving in same direction: Relative speed = S₁ − S₂. In opposite direction: Relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Rounding Rules

If the digit to be dropped is 5 or more, increase the preceding digit by 1 (e.g., 33.745 becomes 33.7 if rounding to 1st decimal).</p
